binary_description: Instrumented release build with unchanged 32 MiB export load limit, identical to cache-load experiment baseline.

method.priming: Clear full analyses in a private copy, review A-to-B through HTTP, retain process, clone its exact native cache state for CLI/fresh-HTTP controls; each timed call reviews A-to-C.
method.identity_check: Digest of full facts, exports, access bindings, rowids and LRU ordering must match before every arm.
method.http_timing: Only command request including response JSON decode; server startup/priming excluded.
method.cli_timing: Process launch through exit including output write; JSON parsing excluded as in earlier CLI benchmarks.
method.isolation: Cancel queued/retry/running jobs only in private copies, reject fixtures with connectors, assert no runnable jobs or graph-projection phases after each HTTP review.
method.memory: Median of each review's maximum sampled current RSS from Graphicle phase logs. Process high-water includes priming for warm HTTP. CLI wait4 maximum also retained; not interchangeable metrics.

excluded_mixed_workload_attempt.reason: Archived queued graph-projection retries ran in normal serve workers during priming. Run interrupted; excluded from isolated latency/memory comparisons.

limitations: Two samples per arm on older local Nexus #963 and platform-rbac #638 archives, not the eight production PR probes.
Sequential requests only; no production throughput, contention, long-term memory-growth or idle-RSS measurement.
Admission, collection, vendoring, priming, cloning, server startup and models excluded from HTTP timing.
CLI and HTTP timing boundaries differ slightly; the fresh-HTTP control isolates process reuse within the same transport.
An idle warmed server remains alive while controls run; unrelated host activity is uncontrolled and OS caches are not flushed.
Isolated copies deliberately suppress background jobs. Normal serve workers and stdio MCP projection drains can perform extra work in a real integration.
Higher warm-server RSS is observed but not attributed to a specific allocator or cache; high-water includes priming.

conclusion.next_requirement: Account for or isolate projection work in a persistent review service before replacing the CLI pilot; benchmark-time job cancellation is not a production strategy.
